# docs/ — built site output

**Generated by `./scripts/build.sh`** — do not edit by hand.

This folder is the **GitHub Pages site root**. `./scripts/publish.sh` copies its contents to the `gh-pages` branch.

## Layout after build

```
docs/
├── index.html          # viewer page (base path /FloodMaps/)
├── .nojekyll
├── css/viewer.css      # copied from web/css/
├── js/
│   ├── catalog.js      # embedded granule catalog
│   └── viewer.js       # copied from web/js/
├── data/
│   └── catalog.json    # granule metadata for fetch()
└── tiles/
    └── {granule_id}/   # PNG tiles z3–z10
        └── {z}/{x}/{y}.png
```

## HPC workflow

**Compute node** (heavy work):

```bash
./scripts/build.sh              # reads geotiffs/, writes docs/ + data/catalog.json
```

**Login node** (git push + deploy trigger):

```bash
# one-time: gh auth login   OR   export GITHUB_TOKEN=<PAT>
# if build ran on another node, rsync docs/ here first
./scripts/publish.sh            # push gh-pages + start deploy workflow
```

Optional env vars for `build.sh`: `WORKERS=8`, `BASE_PATH=/FloodMaps/`.
